description: An agent-first sidebar for fleets of agent threads. Yours keeps every thread you started until you settle it, with search over titles and first prompts, sort and filters. Cloud agents lists agents the desktop does not show (such as Antigravity), from GitHub status notes and a fleet's run map. Specs sort by what needs you; the running card lists every running thread, grouped by spec, with awake, starting and asleep counts. Sections reorder by drag, and wizbar CLI commands with JSON cover every action. Derived from T3 Sidebar.
